scenes.title: A company for one task
scenes.narration: To deliver one task, we built a small company. Then we closed it.
scenes.caption: To deliver one task, we built a small company. Then we closed it.

sources.claim: Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026: teams of 10, 20, 30, 50 roles, almost a mini company, 'just to deliver a task, which fundamentally is what we're doing here'.
sources.title: Start prompt of the Agile Cells film, with Dinis Cruz's words of 28 November 2026

scenes.title: Four values
scenes.narration: In 2001, seventeen people wrote down four values. Individuals and interactions, over processes and tools. Working software, over comprehensive documentation. Customer collaboration, over contract negotiation. Responding to change, over following a plan.

sources.claim: The Manifesto's four values, word for word; seventeen names; '© 2001, the above authors'.
sources.title: Manifesto for Agile Software Development

scenes.on_screen: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools; Working software over comprehensive documentation; Customer collaboration over contract negotiation; Responding to change over following a plan

scenes.title: Can it scale and keep them?
scenes.narration: Agile Cells asks: can Agile scale, and go back to those values? And to focus?
scenes.caption: Can Agile scale, and go back to those values? And to focus?

sources.claim: Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026: Agile can scale and go back to its early values (the four values of the Manifesto, and focus).
sources.title: Start prompt of the Agile Cells film, with Dinis Cruz's words of 28 November 2026

scenes.title: What a cell is
scenes.narration: An agile cell is a small team of people and agents, formed for a piece of work and ended after it. Its roles, its rules and its work are written down as files anyone can read.
scenes.caption: A small team of people and agents, formed for a piece of work and ended after it

sources.claim: An agile cell is a small team of people and agents, formed for a piece of work and ended after it, with its roles, its rules and its work written down as files anyone can read.

scenes.title: Ten roles, or fifty
scenes.narration: A cell can have ten roles, or twenty, thirty, fifty. Almost a mini company, with its own org chart, just to deliver one task.
scenes.caption: Almost a mini company, with its own org chart, for one task

sources.claim: Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026: teams of 10, 20, 30, 50 roles, 'almost the creation of a mini company, a mini organisation, a mini full-blown org chart, just to deliver a task'.
sources.title: Start prompt of the Agile Cells film, with Dinis Cruz's words of 28 November 2026

scenes.title: We did it
scenes.narration: We did this for a film. One person, two maestros on two accounts, a conductor, a lead agent, scene builders, a critic, test viewers and a designer. Set up for one film, and archived when it is done.
